title: Construct one forecast window
question: Which values are observations, and which one is the future target?
summary: The selected timestamp must identify the same history, target, and prediction in every panel.

steps.title: Previous hour
steps.body: The GOES input contains the observed history. A gap invalidates a window rather than becoming an invented reading.

steps.title: Separate target and baseline
steps.body: The observed target is XRS-B at t + 30 minutes. Persistence copies the latest observation as its prediction. The future reading stays outside the input.
steps.excerpt_label: Abbreviated code; full function in notebook.

steps.title: Normalize the input history
steps.body: Use log10 flux and fit input mean and scale on training dates. Validation and final histories reuse them. Targets and persistence remain in log10 flux units.
